messages.subject: position change in procrustes graphs
parts:
Hello, I am carrying out a geometric morphometric analysis on Espeletia seeds and when I obtain the Procrustes graph for each species, I find that in some graphs the silhouette of the landmarks is oriented towards the left (upper part of the seed), and in others it is mirrored, towards the right.
Could this be an error?
Can the graphs be oriented in the same direction? If so, how could I orient them?

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] position change in procrustes graphs
parts:
Without knowing your particular dataset, I suspect that there is some symmetry in your data. That is, you may have some ‘right-handed’ and some ‘left-handed’ shaped seeds.

 

GM methods do not know whether this is a biological signal or whether they need to be reflected.  That is something the user needs to investigate. The functions in geomorph will not automatically reflect objects, as we cannot assume whether this is a biological difference or a user-input issue.

 

If you have such reflections you can reflect them using ‘rotate.coords’ prior to your GPA. The help file provides examples.

Dean
